evidence: CVE-2025-54263 / GHSA-69x9-xp2j-w8g8 is live (NVD vulnStatus Analyzed, GitHub withdrawn_at null, CVE.org CNA Adobe). APSB25-94 lists CWE-863 Incorrect Authorization, impact security-feature-bypass, Auth=Yes, Admin=Yes, CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N, text 'maintain unauthorized access'.

Complete source-to-sink on 2.4.8-p2 52f1fdad463a326a7343bd3f94c6a50f84af7787: Magento\LoginAsCustomerAdminUi\Controller\Adminhtml\Login\Login (ADMIN_RESOURCE Magento_LoginAsCustomer::login) writes AuthenticationData via SaveAuthenticationData into table login_as_customer (admin_id, customer_id, secret hash), then Magento\LoginAsCustomerFrontendUi\Controller\Login\Index consumes the secret through AuthenticateCustomerBySecret::execute which loginById()s the customer and SetLoggedAsCustomerAdminId without re-checking Magento_LoginAsCustomer::login.

IsLoginAsCustomerSessionActive treats any remaining login_as_customer row as an active impersonation session. Pre-fix cleanup is only AdminLogoutPlugin (delete on admin logout). Revoking Magento_LoginAsCustomer::login from the admin role, or moving the user to a role without that resource, leaves the row and storefront impersonation intact — matching APSB25-94 'maintain unauthorized access'.

Atomic fix 485febbd60a1eb28da779024c6c27f856e28ed39 (AC-15021) adds RulesPlugin::afterSaveRel and User::afterSave that call DeleteAuthenticationDataForListOfUser / DeleteAuthenticationDataForUser when Magento_LoginAsCustomer::login is no longer granted; comments: 'Terminate Login as Customer sessions when related permissions are revoked.' Sibling APSB25-94 hunks (EstimateTotals GetCartForUser is storefront/not admin; Sales Order Create loadblock ACL is privilege-escalation C:N-shaped; escapeJs DeleteButtons are CWE-79) do not match CVE-2025-54263's admin+C:H+I:H+maintain-access profile.

Smallest surviving public first-write is dd15e184efe63d3fa5ebdf6d7906ef5874b5fdf2 (Ihor Vansach, 2015-12-12, 'Initial commit'): adds Magefan\LoginAsCustomer Model/Login.php generate() persisting (customer_id, admin_id, secret) into magefan_login_as_customer plus Adminhtml Login controller that issues the secret. Parent 2c4dbba9111184299cba2935b26b23011566ee65 is README-only.

Mechanism: a low-privileged admin who was granted Magento_LoginAsCustomer::login can create a login_as_customer session (SaveAuthenticationData / AuthenticateCustomerBySecret). After that ACL is revoked, no code deleted the row until AC-15021, so impersonation continued (maintain unauthorized access). Auth required, admin required, C:H/I:H.

corrected_fields.bug_semantics: Low-privileged Magento admin with Magento_LoginAsCustomer::login can persist a login_as_customer impersonation row (admin_id, customer_id, secret) consumed by AuthenticateCustomerBySecret without re-checking ACL. After the resource is revoked or the user is moved to a role without it, the row and storefront customer session remain until admin logout. CWE-863 security-feature-bypass; CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N.
corrected_fields.flaw_origin: First persist of Login-as-Customer credentials without invalidation on ACL/role change: dd15e184efe63d3fa5ebdf6d7906ef5874b5fdf2 (Magefan LoginAsCustomer Model/Login.php generate() + magefan_login_as_customer table). Magento 2.4 SaveAuthenticationData is a later refactor of the same store.
